Teen girls fight back after boys ranked their looks - TODAY

My heart broke reading this. It’s hard enough for girls today period. Yay for these girls being strong and taking a very bad situation and turning it into a bold, teachable moment. 
#MeToo https://t.co/38yhdY6hAg

Is this grab them by the p*ssy level? That seems to be ok these days. Can we let Trump slide with his 13 or so accusers vs. a man who may be simply too affectionate in general for the current #MeToo times? Should Biden be investigated to be fair and by whom?
Feels like we need a #MeToo governing body instead of this random court of opinion. I’m exhausted trying to figure out what is true and fair.
